visual.general_description: One-patient timeline infographic of IBS symptoms, failed treatments, FMT dates, questionnaire scores and stool sampling before and after FMT.
visual.detailed_description: Wide infographic with a black time arrow labelled 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024; the upper half shows symptoms and failed treatments and the lower half a gray-shaded zoom with scores and FMT events. A vertical black line with a dot at the far left is labelled "Onset of symptoms"; three light-blue horizontal bands start there: "Abdominal pain", "Alternating bowel habits with severe constipation and paradoxical diarrhoea", and "Burning sensation in the mouth and upper GI". A teal-outlined box titled "Failed treatments" lists three groups. "Various approaches": several antispasmodic drugs; pregabalin and amitriptyline; short course of fentanyl; antidepressants (SSRI); phage therapy in Georgia. "Antibiotics": several courses of rifaximin, ciprofloxacin, amoxicillin, metronidazole. "Dietary Therapy": gluten and lactose withdrawal; a low FODMAPs diet; paleo diet; probiotics (VSL3), prebiotics. A teal bar under the box spans roughly 2020 to 2023 on the time arrow; the box and the bands are joined by crossing blue ribbons. Right side under the heading "After FMT": next to the abdominal pain band, "Resolved after one month post-FMT and maintained after one year."; next to the bowel-habit band, "Improved after four months post-FMT and maintained after one year (2-3 stool/day, Bristol 3-4)"; next to the burning band, "No modification". Below the arrow at far left, rotated labels "Depressive episode" and "Laparoscopy" mark two ticks near 2020; a light-blue bar labelled "Suspicion of IBS" runs under the arrow with a small tick; a black marker with "IBS diagnosis confirmation (Rome IV- IBS-C )" sits at about the 2023 position. Lower half in a gray trapezoid: three horizontal gradient bars (orange at left to green at right). IBS-SSS: 413, 373, 150, 183. EQ5D5L (%): 4, 45, 70, 80. BSS: an orange box "Jan.-Feb. 1; 6-7" then 4, 6, 4, 5, 4, 4, 4, 4. A black lower timeline carries icons: "Vancomycin 5 days", "Bowel cleansing", a brown stool icon "Pre-FMT", then FMT 1 (dates 28.03 and 29.03, two capsule icons), FMT 2 (04.04 and 11.04), FMT 3 (18.04 and 25.04), and, after a gap under "Post-FMT", stool icons M1 (23.05), M4 (07.09), M6 (07.11) and a final segment labelled "July". A boxed legend at lower left reads: gray capsule = "FMT treatment 20 capsules", brown stool = "Stool samples collection", "SSRI: selective serotonin reuptake inhibitors".

visual.general_description: Three-panel microbiome figure: alpha-diversity bar charts, a five-set Venn diagram of genera, and a heat-map table of relative abundance by sample intersection.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A: Two side-by-side bar-chart facets titled "Observed" (y ticks 0 to 400) and "Shannon" (y ticks 0 to 4) with the y-axis label "Index value (species level)". Each facet has five bars in the order FMT_donor (orange), Pre-FMT, 1M-post-FMT, 4M-post-FMT, 6M-post-FMT (blue). Observed: donor lowest (about 350) and recipient samples about 373 to 413. Shannon: donor highest (about 4.5) and recipient samples about 3.7 to 4.1. A legend "Sample origin" shows orange = FMT donor and blue = Recipient. Panel B: A five-ellipse Venn diagram with set labels FMT donor, Pre-FMT, 1M-post-FMT, 4M-post-FMT and 6M-post-FMT. Each region prints a genera count with a percentage in parentheses, shaded by a "count" colour scale (blue near 0 to red near 80+). The central all-set region prints 87 (34%) in red; a lower central region prints 27 (11%) in yellow-green. Outer regions print 10 (4%) for the donor, 17 (7%) for Pre-FMT, 9 (4%) for 6M-post-FMT, 4 (2%) for 4M-post-FMT and 5 (2%) for 1M-post-FMT, with other interior regions between 0 and 9. Panel C: A heat-map style table with columns Donor, Pre-FMT, M1, M4, M6 and rows grouped into five labelled blocks (Cores, Cores variation, Patient variation, Engraftment var., Acquisition) under the vertical axis title "Intersection". Each row is a sample intersection such as Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 or Donor/Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6; printed cells give an RA sum shaded by a dark-blue-to-pale-yellow "RA sum" scale. The Cores block shows Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 = 20.332 (Pre-FMT), 5.947 (M1), 1.887 (M4), 3.381 (M6) and Donor/Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 = 78.161, 50.43, 53.361, 93.644, 79.731 (Donor to M6). Smaller values fill the variation and acquisition blocks; all printed cells are listed in the chart readings.

evidence.quote: Using 16S rRNA amplicon-based metagenomics, we analyzed the microbiota composition of patient’s fecal samples collected before FMT and 1, 4, and 6 months post-FMT, as well as the composition of the donor stool administered as capsules

mentioned_categories.value: core, core variation, patient variation, engraftment variation, acquisition categories

pixel_observations: A heat-map style table with columns Donor, Pre-FMT, M1, M4, M6 and rows grouped into five labelled blocks (Cores, Cores variation, Patient variation, Engraftment var., Acquisition) under the vertical axis title "Intersection". Each row is a sample intersection such as Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 or Donor/Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6; printed cells give an RA sum shaded by a dark-blue-to-pale-yellow "RA sum" scale. The Cores block shows Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 = 20.332 (Pre-FMT), 5.947 (M1), 1.887 (M4), 3.381 (M6) and Donor/Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 = 78.161, 50.43, 53.361, 93.644, 79.731 (Donor to M6). Smaller values fill the variation and acquisition blocks; all printed cells are listed in the chart readings.

caption_claims.value: Relative abundance of the genera in each intersection of samples with five categories

evidence.quote: (C) Relative abundance (RA) of the genera in each intersection of samples.
This reduction suggests a gradual engraftment of the donor microbiota and replacement of the patient’s original microbiota

clinical_significance.statement: The authors read the fall of the patient-specific core as gradual engraftment of donor microbiota and replacement of the patient's original microbiota.

limitations: The printed Pre-FMT/M1/M4/M6 value at M6 is 3.381, whereas the text states the patient-specific core fell to less than 3% at 6 months; not reconciled.
The printed acquisition-category values are far below the 11.5% environmental-acquisition average stated in the discussion; not reconciled.
Both color (OC) and grayscale (PB) renditions were viewed; they show the same content.
Samples are the FMT donor material plus the patient stool samples; donor columns are reference data, not patient attributes.

visual.general_description: Genus-by-sample heat map of relative abundance (%) for donor material and patient stool samples, with an inset bar plot of two Bacteroides species.
visual.detailed_description: A heat map with the title "Relative abundance of taxa per sample": 42 genera (y-axis "Genus", italic names, several PAC-coded unclassified genera) by five samples on the x-axis "Sample": Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6. Each cell prints its relative abundance value on a pale-yellow to dark-blue scale labelled "value" (0 to over 30); blank cells mean absent. Largest values are Bacteroides 32.33 at M4 and 27.81 at M6, Akkermansia 18.6 and Dialister 15.55 at Pre-FMT, and Prevotella 16.52 at M1. Genus names are coloured green, periwinkle blue or orange, or are black. A gray inset at the bottom right shows stacked bars for Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6 with purple B. uniformis and yellow B. vulgatus (the M4 bar reaches about 10.8).

panels.general_description: Heat map of genus relative abundances (%) in the FMT donor material and the patient stool samples before and after FMT, with an inset bar plot of two Bacteroides species.
panels.detailed_description: A heat map with the title "Relative abundance of taxa per sample": 42 genera (y-axis "Genus", italic names, several PAC-coded unclassified genera) by five samples on the x-axis "Sample": Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6. Each cell prints its relative abundance value on a pale-yellow to dark-blue scale labelled "value" (0 to over 30); blank cells mean absent. Largest values are Bacteroides 32.33 at M4 and 27.81 at M6, Akkermansia 18.6 and Dialister 15.55 at Pre-FMT, and Prevotella 16.52 at M1. Genus names are coloured green, periwinkle blue or orange, or are black. A gray inset at the bottom right shows stacked bars for Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6 with purple B. uniformis and yellow B. vulgatus (the M4 bar reaches about 10.8).

pixel_observations: A heat map with the title "Relative abundance of taxa per sample": 42 genera (y-axis "Genus", italic names, several PAC-coded unclassified genera) by five samples on the x-axis "Sample": Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6. Each cell prints its relative abundance value on a pale-yellow to dark-blue scale labelled "value" (0 to over 30); blank cells mean absent. Largest values are Bacteroides 32.33 at M4 and 27.81 at M6, Akkermansia 18.6 and Dialister 15.55 at Pre-FMT, and Prevotella 16.52 at M1. Genus names are coloured green, periwinkle blue or orange, or are black. A gray inset at the bottom right shows stacked bars for Pre-FMT, Donor, M1, M4, M6 with purple B. uniformis and yellow B. vulgatus (the M4 bar reaches about 10.8).

Examples read from the cells: Akkermansia 18.6 (Pre-FMT), blank (Donor), 4.19 (M1), 0.62 (M4), 0.01 (M6); Dialister 15.55, 6.84, 1.45, blank, 0.01; Prevotella 7.11, 0.83, 16.52, 0.12, blank; Phascolarctobacterium 0.01, 6.05, 1.21, 2.67, 7.07; Alloprevotella blank, 1.39, 1.77, 1, 0.64; Coprococcus blank, 0.53, 2.73, blank, blank.

evidence.quote: Genera of the shared core taxa (present in all samples) are color-coded if there were boosted by FMT (green), increased after FMT (blue), or reduced by FMT (orange) by at least a two-fold change from pre-fmt to M6 post-fmt. Names in black remained stable.

caption_claims.value: bottom-right bar-plot of two Bacteroides species defined as gatekeepers

evidence.quote: Bottom-right bar-plot represents the relative abundance (%) per sample of two Bacteroides species defined as “gatekeepers” by reference.
Genera boosted by FMT include Alistipes, Phascolarctobacterium, Lachnospira, and Sporobacter (Figure 3)
B. uniformis and B. vulgatus have been suggested as “gatekeepers” of the recipient’s microbiota and their highest RA at 4 months post-FMT (Figure 3)

clinical_significance.statement: The authors use these abundances to point to boosted, increased and reduced genera and to the post-FMT rise of Bacteroides and of B. uniformis and B. vulgatus.

limitations: Donor column is reference material, not a patient attribute.
The text says Akkermansia is nearly 20% pre-FMT (printed 18.6) and Prevotella nearly one-fifth at one month (printed 16.52); these are consistent approximations, not conflicts.
Both color (OC) and grayscale (PB) renditions were viewed; the grayscale one loses the genus-name colour coding.
Inset bar values are estimates; all heat-map cells are printed values.
